Description:
An elegant amalgamation of everything the Eversong Woods embody. Seemingly designed to perfection, it is both bountiful in the Eversong waters and as a food source. Rounded lines taper across its slender body perfectly resembling Blood Elf architecture.

Special:

Fresh Fillet

Salvaging this fish with the Cooking skill can produce a large amount of Fresh Fillet.

Areas you can find this fish:
- Eversong Woods

Fishing Pools:
- Sunwell Swarm
- Bubbling Bloom
- Bloom Swarm

Rates:
- This fish is mostly found in pools.

Discovery: Fishing
